nodes.name: Profile Info from front (CV pdf, City, Position)

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Candidate first name from the CV

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Candidate last name from the CV

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn profile URL if present in the CV, otherwise empty

attributes.name: profile_summary
attributes.description: A concise 1-2 sentence professional summary of the candidate

attributes.name: skills
attributes.description: Technical/professional skills explicitly stated in the CV

attributes.name: education
attributes.description: Education entries explicitly stated in the CV

attributes.name: experience
attributes.description: Work experience entries explicitly stated in the CV

attributes.name: previous_companies
attributes.description: Names of companies the candidate previously worked at

attributes.name: languages
attributes.description: Languages the candidate speaks, from the CV

attributes.name: preferred_industries
attributes.description: Industries the candidate is targeting, if inferable

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Employment type such as full-time/part-time, if stated

attributes.name: salary_min
attributes.description: Minimum salary if explicitly stated, otherwise empty

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You are an expert extraction algorithm building a candidate profile.
Extract only facts explicitly supported by the CV or the user-provided position/city.
Never invent skills, experience, education, languages, salary, or preferences.
If information is missing, leave the field empty. Preserve technologies exactly.
